leaked_early.details: No confirmed pre-deal rumors exist for Mersana Therapeutics, Inc. (MRSN) prior to the official announcement.

notes: The deal included a CVR worth up to $30.25 per share tied to Emi-Le milestones, reflecting the high-risk, high-reward nature of the lead Phase 1 asset. The reverse stock split in August 2025 makes pre-split price comparisons unreliable without adjustment.
